fact: The finance ministry's special projects unit issued terms of reference for developing the Territory Management modules of SIMple, a planned successor to the municipal system, covering cadastre, property assessment and property tax collection; the document gives its own date as 2025 and no month.

The terms of reference for the SIMple Territory Management modules are funded from a USD 15 million World Bank credit for the Harmonization and Improvement of Statistics in West Africa Project (HISWAP) Cabo Verde.
